Strategy: Give a bonus to post-placement residuals between one third and one half of the item, and a penalty just above that band, so bins keep a small usable leftover instead of a large loose one. It may help by preserving mid-size residuals, but may fail if items rarely leave leftovers in that narrow window.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r - item >= item / 3 and r - item <= item / 2 else 0) - (15 if r - item > item / 2 and r - item <= item else 0) for r in bins]
```
